title: Confronting a Bad Habit
paragraphs: After noticing he had developed a habit of speaking harshly to his wife whenever he felt stressed at work, Adil initially dismissed the pattern as simply an unavoidable side effect of a demanding career.

It was only after his wife calmly pointed out specific recent examples, rather than making a vague general complaint, that Adil truly recognized how consistently the pattern had been repeating itself.

Rather than becoming defensive, he asked her to point out the behavior gently whenever it happened again, a request that required considerable humility given how uncomfortable it felt to invite ongoing correction.
The first few reminders stung his pride noticeably, but Adil gradually noticed himself catching the harsh tone before speaking, pausing briefly to reconsider his words in moments of frustration.
Six months into this deliberate effort, his wife mentioned that the change, though gradual, had been genuinely noticeable, and their overall relationship felt considerably more peaceful as a result.

Adil later reflected that recognizing a flaw was relatively easy, but the harder, more valuable work was consistently inviting correction and genuinely changing behavior over an extended period of time.
